overview:
Nai Yang is in the north-west of Phuket, in Thalang district, next to Nai Yang Beach and Sirinat National Park. The airport is only a short drive away: the project data gives about 2 km (7 minutes) for Botanica Skyport and descriptions of the condominiums put it at five to ten minutes, which is the main practical difference from the southern and central west-coast areas.
Most projects here are condominiums, mainly from Rhom Bho Property (The Title) plus The Balcony, The Olive, The Nayabella Condominium and one project by The Zero, and several are pre-sale or under construction with units listed under the foreign quota. Botanica Skyport is a pool-villa project for buyers who want a house near the airport; the area is also close to Blue Canyon Golf Club and Mai Khao.
